title: Group numbers in an array
summary: Fortran: Group numbers in an array. Change one score.
introduction: An array stores several values. This array has three integer positions.
learningObjectives: Group numbers in an array with Fortran

blocks.text: Install GNU Fortran. Save each example as lesson.f90, run gfortran -std=f2008 lesson.f90 -o lesson, then run it.

blocks.title: Group numbers in an array
blocks.code:
program lesson
  implicit none
integer :: scores(3) = [4, 5, 8]
write(*,'(3(I0,1X))') scores
end program lesson

blocks.text: The array has three values. The repeated I0 format prints each whole number.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Array sizes and initial value counts must agree.
